about: One row per connector of the G36 composites: its class (point, signal or unclear), the Project Haystack point spec that answers it or the gap where ph has none, its binding scope, and the point meta the generator writes on it. The point specs name ph, ph.points and ph.points.x at Project Haystack xeto commit 23be968cdf07dd23ce59c69a159608084c363451; every spec named also exists at 8ba9d7ffc3fe8ace52070f9b0bdc9239ad36a9f5. The G36 composites are those generated from MBL 14.0.0 (ad48324b) via modelica-json 5460add3.
